text:
Marta (AE): Quick sync on Greenline Retail POC kickoff. Need to lock endpoints, success criteria, pricing ask, and security questionnaire blockers. High level: product-discovery chat, personalized recommendations (catalog embeddings + rerank), and an in-store assistant flow. Can SE + Security weigh in?

Ben (SE): SG. Integration-wise keep it minimal: 3 endpoints we should expose for the POC: `/v1/chat.generate` (session + persona), `/v1/embeddings.encode` (product catalog), `/v1/rerank` (candidate reranking).

Ben (SE): sample curl for embeddings:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
 -d '{"model":"rw-embed-1", "input":["Red fleece jacket", "Blue running shoes"]}'
```

Ajay (Solutions Eng): For perf, main knobs: batching + KV cache for chat, prefix caching for product descriptions, and a small rerank model (distilled) to keep latency sub-300ms for 95th pct on hosted. If they want <200ms we should consider Dedicated with reserved GPUs.

Riley (Product): Success criteria proposal (POC):
- Functional: chat handles product lookup + add-to-cart flow end-to-end
- Quality: retrieval R@1 >= 0.7, rerank NDCG@5 improvement > 15% vs baseline
- Latency: chat roundtrip p95 <= 500ms (goal 300ms)
- Safety: hallucination rate (false product claims) < 5% on eval set
- Business: pilot traffic -> +3% conversion on test segment (soft)

Priya (Security): Checklist items now:
- Data classification: will PII/PCI be sent? They said product SKUs + store-level inventory; no CC data in POC, but confirm.
- Access: require SSO (SAML) + least-privilege API keys for engineers.
- Logs: redact SKUs and customer identifiers in logs; retention 30 days for POC data.
- Compliance: will need to run our vendor security questionnaire and provide SOC2 summary.
- Ask: can we host in eu-west-1 for their EU stores?

Marta (AE): They said no card data in the POC, but store staff might paste order IDs (considered internal). Good to push EU region. Assigning security Q to Priya.

SecurityBot: New vendor security questionnaire assigned to Priya (Security) — link: https://okta.enterprise/questionnaires/greenline-poc

Ben (SE): Pricing note for sales: rough cost envelopes (very approximate):
- Hosted API: ~$0.60 per 1k chat tokens + $0.10 per 1k embedding units (depends on model & length)
- Dedicated (monthly reserve): starting around $10k/mo for a small pool (gives predictable p95 latency and throughput)
If Greenline expects ~10k queries/day (chat + 1 embed per query) hosted might be fine to start.

Marta (AE): They asked for a formal cost estimate for 30-day pilot at 10k queries/day. Can SE do a ballpark by EOD?

Ajay (Solutions Eng): I can draft numbers. Also need expected QPS and avg tokens per chat (prompt+response). For budget assume 200 tokens per chat on average. Quick calc: 10k * 200 = 2M tokens/day -> hosted costs multiply. If they want cost predictability recommend Dedicated commit.

Priya (Security): Two blockers to unblock before full POC sign-off: 1) confirm EU hosting for EU customers, 2) provide data handling doc + redaction plan. I need the POC data sample (anonymized) to sign off.

Riley (Product): Eval plan suggestion:
- Build a 2k prompt eval set across 3 journeys: discovery, comparison, checkout-assist.
- Metrics: exact match for SKU retrieval, R@1, NDCG@5 for rerank, hallucination count.
- Run baseline (current search) vs Redwood-backed pipeline.

Marta (AE): Proposed timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): finalize security Q answers + get anonymized sample data to Priya
- Week 1: integration (endpoints wired, API keys, SSO test)
- Week 2: model selection + run 2k evals, iterate prompts
- Week 3: performance tuning (batching, caching) + user acceptance
- Week 4: demo + go/no-go and pricing finalize

Ben (SE): Action items for me: provide endpoint spec + skeleton integration README by tomorrow; estimate infra cost for 10k/day with both hosted and dedicated options.

Ajay (Solutions Eng): Action items: prepare eval harness + sample prompts (I'll seed 500 prompts Friday), recommend model family (rw-chat-3 / quantized variant) and a reranker config.

Priya (Security): Action items: I'll start the vendor questionnaire today. Provide anonymized sample data to me (S3 link with encryption) and confirm region.

Marta (AE): I'll loop in Legal for the data transfer note and ping Greenline to confirm they can provide anonymized sample by EOD tomorrow. Also need a simple one-page POC spec to send them (I can draft).

Riley (Product): Quick behavioral ask: please label top 100 SKU edge-cases where current search fails — that'll speed iteration.

Marta (AE): Great. Summarizing assignees: Ben -> integration + pricing calc, Ajay -> eval harness + model recs, Priya -> security Q + data signoff, Riley -> eval targets, Marta -> one-pager + legal. Back here after estimates. :thumbsup:

Ben (SE): ACK.

Ajay (Solutions Eng): ACK.

Priya (Security): ACK, starting now.

Marta (AE): If anything blocks, call out here and I'll escalate to AM.

SecurityBot: Reminder scheduled: vendor questionnaire due in 72 hours to Priya (Security).
